in_hebrew.name: גִלוּס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew verb 'galah' which means 'to roll away, depart, or go back'. Gilus may be a derivative of this verb and could mean 'backsliding', 'fugitive', or 'renegade'. This name may have been given to someone who had turned away from God or who was in a state of rebellion.
